references.text: Israel asked Edom for permission to pass through their country on the main road without turning to the right or to the left, a request almost identical to the one made to Sihon.
Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, with the same request to pass through his land on the main road without turning to the right or to the left.
Moses urged the people to walk in the way the Lord had commanded, without turning to the right or to the left.
The people must follow the law exactly without turning to the right or to the left, the same expression used for staying on the path.
The condition for blessing is not to turn to the right or to the left from the Lord's commands, the same wording as in the travel request.
The Lord commanded Joshua not to turn to the right or to the left from the law, a parallel to sticking strictly to the designated path.
Proverbs urges one not to turn to the right or to the left, but to keep one's foot away from evil, the same principle of staying on the right path.
